source.generator: Actor, verb, object and manner lexical; auxiliary and negation plus verb morphology depend on tense+negative. Present affirmative inflects verb; past affirmative inflects past; other cases bare verb. 8 aligned synthetic chunks. No natural language complexity beyond this predeclared grammar.

source.input: Every fit arm observes IDENTICAL six-field categorical public input and eight target aligned chunks; no source oracle or gold accessible to inference.

arms.NAR_H13: Train 13-unit tanh semantic+slot encoder with independent categorical output per slot; no preceding chunk input.
arms.RNN_H12: Train 12-unit recurrent tanh hidden state conditioned on semantic onehot and preceding target chunk during TRAIN, preceding GENERATED chunk during inference; full BPTT.
arms.SSM_DIAGONAL_H14: Train 14-unit diagonal sigmoid-retention state space update and tanh innovation with semantic onehot and preceding target/generated chunk; full BPTT.
arms.PARALLEL_CATEGORICAL_4: Original L2 categorical trained parallel implementation byte-identical blob 05fe6da94ab4a11f0f49aaa5a5ed83c171f865d5; input subsets <=4 selected L3_SELECT only.
arms.UNCONDITIONAL: Original categorical unconditional fitted counts; negative control.

train.seed_selection: FIT SELECT mean per-target-chunk NLL only; no DEV selection.
train.neural_same_epochs: 12 epochs each, two independent starts; optimize all eight chunks via teacher-forced cross-entropy; capacity fixed H13/H12/H14; report parameter mismatch, total CPU, checkpoint and MAC proxies.
